answer: Graduated quotas make a sybil army climb a long ladder before it earns. A new identity starts with 2 slots; each verified epoch adds 2, up to 40, and 3 idle epochs drop it back by 4. There is no haven for bought accounts: a purchased identity resets to 2 slots, history lost. Forgery resets the quota to 2 and freezes rewards 6 epochs; a repeat offence doubles the climb. 1,000 high-quota identities need 19 epochs of genuine work each, costing 152,000 units, while a wander through shortcuts ends at the bottom. Like an orchard, quotas bear fruit only after tending.
